about: Stories come from the shared bank: games/shared/stories.json (50+ per level, shuffled every game). This file has the How to play slides and bonus cards.

intro.title: Spot the Mistakes
text: This story has three mistakes in it.

example.big: Yesterday I goed to the park.

intro.title: Fix them
text: Write each mistake and the right word.

intro.title: Win points
text: Mistakes can be verbs, words or grammar.

before.name: Explain it
before.text: Say WHY one word is wrong: +1

before.name: Silent search
before.text: No talking: point and write only: +2

secret.name: Eagle eyes
secret.text: +2 for the first team to find all three!

secret.name: Read it right
secret.text: +1 if your team reads the fixed story aloud!
